mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, status FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT goods_id AS goodsId, status FROM tb_goods_master WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId}
SELECT sales_id AS salesId, goods_id AS goodsId, status FROM tb_goods_sales WHERE sales_id = #{salesId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_session ( session_id, member_id, goods_id, sales_id, status, expire_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{memberId}, #{goodsId}, #{salesId}, #{status}, #{expireAt} )
